lore_notes: The fissure Zevara spoke of is down past the gallery. The dark has a direction today.
East past the gate road, across the floodplains — this is the ruin. Survey stakes, a banked fire, washing on a line: the Horns got here first. The sealed level is deeper in, under the pedestal court.

Below the pedestal: not treasure. A door, unhung, unmarked, utterly ordinary except that four adventurers go silent around it at once. Ceria, finally: 'That's wardwork. Old, fed wardwork. We're taking it home.' The anchor stone comes up with it.
[Detect Magic] — The socket still remembers its stone: a slow pulse, counting toward a door that already left. The warding reads near-first: the spiral beside the pedestal, then its far twin.

[Observe] — The grain of the frame isn't grain at all: a pattern worked into the wood, old and deliberate, repeating all the way around the jamb. It holds still while you watch it and shifts the moment you look away.
[Detect Magic] — Light runs under the turf in one long seam, straight through the stone and away west. The hollow is built on a current.
Pisces reaches the door before you do and stops a handspan short of it. "The same hand. One person's work, and this door was the first of it." He does not look away while he says it.

Pisces steps back at last. "The lines run one way. They have run one way for a very long time, and something on the far side has been drinking the whole while. Your inn has a frame by this hand. Sleep well."
